Comic watermark removal uses the SLBR model:
Visible Watermark Removal via Self-calibrated Localization and Background Refinement
Jing Liang, Li Niu, Fengjun Guo, Teng Long and Liqing Zhang, ACM Multimedia 2021.

Official source: https://github.com/bcmi/SLBR-Visible-Watermark-Removal
Official checkpoint: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uTCzubnWZtu3HIXaK8xsXX-7x302ss13/view

The application imports a separately exported ONNX model. The authors' repository
provides the paper and checkpoint; an explicit source/weight license remains to
be supplied by the authors. Distribution terms require clarification before
public release of the model.

ONNX Runtime uses the existing sherpa-onnx runtime dependency. Its MIT license
and third-party notices are retained with the existing offline TTS notices.
The native bridge uses the ONNX Runtime 1.17.3 public C API header, under MIT.
